books.title: Summer
books.art_why: Summer weather, beaches, flowers and gardens are real things a camera can show today.

pages.brief: A bright yellow sun shines high in a clear blue sky above a warm open yard, with strong sunlight falling on the grass and the rooftops below, making everything look golden and bright on a hot summer day.

Grey summer clouds open up and rain falls in steady lines over a green backyard, drops splashing on the leaves and the grass, with wet ground and small puddles forming below as the summer shower comes down.

A wide sandy beach meets calm blue ocean water, gentle waves rolling in and spreading white foam across the sand, with open sky above and smooth wet sand shining near the water's edge on a bright summer day.

A bright child's swimsuit lies spread out on warm dry sand, its colourful fabric clearly shown against the pale beach, ready for summer swimming, with soft sunlight falling on it and a little sand stuck to the cloth.

A round colourful ball sits on warm ground outdoors, its bright panels clearly visible, resting still in the summer sunshine with soft shadows around it and open space behind, waiting to be played with on a sunny day.

Summer flowers bloom in bright colours, petals open wide on their green stems with leaves all around them, growing close together outdoors in warm sunlight, filling the view with reds, yellows and pinks on a sunny day.

A garden full of green plants and growing vegetables spreads out in neat rows, leaves and stems standing tall in the warm summer sun, with soft soil between the plants and bright light falling across the whole garden.

Warm summer sunshine pours over a wide outdoor view, bright light on green plants and open ground, with a clear bright sky above and everything looking warm and dry, showing the long sunny days of the summer season.

books.title: My School Bus
books.art_why: A school bus and school routine are real-world things a camera can show.

pages.brief: A young child wearing a backpack walks along a plain outdoor sidewalk on the way to the school bus stop. The child is seen from a short distance, moving forward in ordinary daylight, with simple surroundings and no other people nearby.

The same young child sits on a simple bench at a school bus stop, waiting quietly with a backpack beside them. The bench is outdoors on a sidewalk, and the child faces forward, calm and ready for the bus to come.

A yellow school bus stops at the curb near the waiting child. The bus is shown from the side or front, large and clear, with its wheels on the road and the child standing nearby with a backpack, ready to get on.
The school bus door is open, and the young child stands close to the entrance with a backpack. The open doorway is clear, showing the first step inside the bus, with the child about to board.

The young child climbs the steps into the school bus, holding the handrail and wearing a backpack. The steps are visible inside the open bus doorway, and the child is mid-climb, moving up into the bus.
The young child sits in a school bus seat, wearing a backpack and facing forward. The seat is clearly shown inside the bus, with the child settled and ready for the ride to school.
The young child looks out the school bus window, with a backpack nearby. The window shows a simple outdoor view, and the child is seated inside the bus, watching the way to school through the glass.

A school building stands at the end of the ride, with the young child walking toward it. The school is shown clearly outdoors, and the child with a backpack approaches the entrance, ready to start the school day.

books.title: Lunch at School
books.art_why: Real school lunch items and children that exist in the everyday world today.

pages.brief: A young child stands smiling beside two friends in a bright school lunchroom, the three of them close together near a table, all looking toward the reader with happy faces. Simple windows and a plain wall behind them.
The same young child holds up a school bag with both hands, showing it at chest height. The bag is plain, sturdy and open at the top, held in the school lunchroom with tables and chairs behind.
The child sits at the lunch table and holds a small carton of milk in one hand, ready to drink. The carton rests upright on the table edge, with the child's face and the lunchroom behind.
A bowl of noodles sits on the lunch table in front of the young child, who looks down at it and holds a fork. Steam rises faintly from the noodles; the lunchroom table and chairs surround them.
Several small orange carrots lie on a plate on the lunch table. The young child's hand reaches toward them, fingers open, while the child sits at the table in the school lunchroom.
The young child holds a round cookie in one hand, lifted near the face, smiling at it. The cookie is plain and golden, held above the lunch table with the lunchroom softly behind.
A folded paper napkin lies flat on the lunch table beside the child's plate. The young child's hand rests near it, smoothing it down, while the child sits at the table in the lunchroom.
The young child sits proudly in front of a full lunch: milk carton, bowl of noodles, carrots, a cookie and a napkin spread on the table. The child smiles widely with both hands on the table edge.

books.title: Colorful Eggs
books.art_why: Colored eggs are real objects that can be photographed today.

pages.brief: One whole egg, painted a deep even red, standing alone in the middle of a soft pale surface. Its smooth curved shell catches gentle light along the top, with a faint shadow resting underneath. Nothing else is in the frame, so the red egg fills the picture from every side.

A single egg in bright sunny yellow sits alone on a plain light surface. Soft light shines along its rounded shell, showing the smooth curve from top to bottom, and a faint shadow spreads beneath it. The whole picture holds just this one yellow egg.

One pink egg, soft and rosy, rests by itself in the centre of a plain pale background. Gentle light gleams on the smooth rounded shell and a small shadow sits under the egg. No other object appears, so the pink egg is the only thing to see.

A single purple egg stands alone on a simple light surface. The deep violet shell looks smooth and slightly glossy, with a soft highlight curving over the top and a faint shadow underneath. The frame is empty apart from this one purple egg.

One orange egg, warm and bright, sits by itself in the middle of a plain pale surface. Light slides over its smooth rounded shell, leaving a gentle glow along the curve and a soft shadow beneath. Only the orange egg is shown.

A single green egg rests alone on a plain light background. Its smooth shell is a fresh grassy green, with a soft shine along the top curve and a small shadow spreading beneath it. Nothing else is pictured here except the green egg.

One blue egg, clear and bright, stands alone in the centre of a simple pale surface. Light glints softly along its smooth shell and a faint shadow lies underneath. The picture shows only this blue egg, filling the empty space around it.

A single egg covered in many colors at once, red and yellow and pink and purple and orange and green and blue, rests on a plain light surface. Its smooth shell shines gently, with a soft shadow beneath. Only this one colorful egg is in the picture.

books.title: The Street
books.art_why: Real street objects can be photographed.

pages.brief: A clear photo shows a gate as the main subject. The gate stands in a simple outdoor setting, with its frame and opening easy to see. The view is bright and direct, and the gate fills the center of the picture.
A clear photo shows a mailbox as the main subject. The mailbox stands beside a street, with its box and post visible. The view is bright and simple, and the mailbox fills the center of the picture.

A clear photo shows a sidewalk as the main subject. The sidewalk stretches across the picture, with a smooth surface and a straight edge easy to see. The view is bright and simple, and the sidewalk fills the center.

A clear photo shows a fence as the main subject. The fence stands in a simple outdoor setting, with its posts and rails easy to see. The view is bright and direct, and the fence fills the center of the picture.

A clear photo shows flowers as the main subject. The flowers grow together in a simple outdoor setting, with petals and leaves easy to see. The view is bright and close, and the flowers fill the center of the picture.

A clear photo shows a bike as the main subject. The bike stands on a street, with its wheels, frame, and handlebars easy to see. The view is bright and simple, and the bike fills the center of the picture.

A clear photo shows a friend as the main subject. The friend stands outdoors on a street, facing the camera with a calm, friendly look. The view is bright and simple, and the friend fills the center of the picture.

A clear photo shows a street as the main subject. The street stretches across the picture, with a clear road surface and simple edges easy to see. The view is bright and open, and the street fills the center of the picture.

books.title: Two
books.art_why: Real animals can be photographed.

pages.brief: Exactly two bees are shown together as the only subject of this picture. The brief focus is on the two bees, with nothing else added to the scene. They are presented clearly and simply for a very young reader to look at.

Exactly two fish are shown together as the only subject of this picture. The brief focus is on the two fish, with nothing else added to the scene. They are presented clearly and simply for a very young reader to look at.

Exactly two birds are shown together as the only subject of this picture. The brief focus is on the two birds, with nothing else added to the scene. They are presented clearly and simply for a very young reader to look at.

Exactly two cats are shown together as the only subject of this picture. The brief focus is on the two cats, with nothing else added to the scene. They are presented clearly and simply for a very young reader to look at.

Exactly two dogs are shown together as the only subject of this picture. The brief focus is on the two dogs, with nothing else added to the scene. They are presented clearly and simply for a very young reader to look at.

Exactly two cows are shown together as the only subject of this picture. The brief focus is on the two cows, with nothing else added to the scene. They are presented clearly and simply for a very young reader to look at.

Exactly two horses are shown together as the only subject of this picture. The brief focus is on the two horses, with nothing else added to the scene. They are presented clearly and simply for a very young reader to look at.

Exactly two kids are shown together as the only subject of this picture. The brief focus is on the two kids, with nothing else added to the scene. They are presented clearly and simply for a very young reader to look at.

books.title: Four
books.art_why: All the vehicles are real things that exist today, so photographs suit this counting book.

pages.brief: Four buses are shown together, each one a large passenger vehicle with windows and wheels, lined up so all four can be seen clearly against a plain, simple background.
Four wagons are shown together, each one a wheeled vehicle with a flat or open body, arranged in a row so all four are easy to count against a plain background.
Four cars are shown together, each one a small road vehicle with windows and wheels, lined up side by side so all four are clearly visible against a plain background.
Four carts are shown together, each one a simple wheeled vehicle, arranged in a row so all four can be seen and counted clearly against a plain, simple background.
Four airplanes are shown together, each one with wings and a tail, arranged so all four are clearly visible against a plain sky-like background.
Four boats are shown together, each one a water vehicle with a hull, lined up so all four can be seen and counted clearly against a plain background.
Four trucks are shown together, each one a large vehicle with a cab and a load area, arranged in a row so all four are clearly visible against a plain background.
Four vans are shown together, each one a boxy vehicle with windows and wheels, lined up side by side so all four can be seen clearly against a plain background.

books.title: Rainforest Animals
books.art_why: Rainforest animals are real and can be photographed today.

pages.brief: A cat is shown alone in the center of the picture. It stands on four paws with its tail relaxed and ears up, looking calmly ahead. Its fur and face are clear and easy to see. The background is plain and simple, keeping all attention on the cat.

A monkey is shown alone in the center of the picture. It sits upright with its hands resting near its knees, looking forward with a curious face. Its long tail curls beside it. The background is simple and plain so the monkey stands out clearly.

A frog is shown alone in the center of the picture. It sits low with its front legs planted and its back legs folded, looking straight ahead. Its wide eyes and smooth skin are clear. The background is simple and plain so the frog is easy to see.

A parrot is shown alone in the center of the picture. It stands upright with its wings folded and its head turned slightly, looking alert. Its curved beak and bright feathers are clear. The background is simple and plain so the parrot stands out.

A snake is shown alone in the center of the picture. Its long body curves across the ground, and its head lifts slightly as it looks forward. Its scales and eyes are clear. The background is simple and plain so the snake is easy to see.

A butterfly is shown alone in the center of the picture. It rests with its wings spread open, showing their shape and pattern. Its small body and thin antennae are clear. The background is simple and plain so the butterfly stands out.

A beetle is shown alone in the center of the picture. It stands on its small legs with its hard shell and rounded body clearly visible. Its antennae point forward as it faces ahead. The background is simple and plain so the beetle is easy to see.

A wide view of a rainforest fills the picture. Tall trees rise with dense green leaves, vines hang between trunks, and thick plants cover the ground. Soft mist drifts among the trees. The whole rainforest scene is green, shady, and full of growth.

books.title: Plains Animals
books.art_why: All the animals and the plains exist in the real world and can be photographed.

pages.brief: A single fox stands on the open grassy plain, its reddish coat and pointed ears clearly visible, body turned towards the viewer as it pauses on the dry ground. Short grass stretches around its paws, and the wide sky behind it is bright and open.

A large elephant walks slowly across the flat grassland, its trunk hanging down and its big ears spread wide. Its heavy legs press into the dry ground, and dust and short grass are around its feet under a wide, open sky.

A tall giraffe stands on the plains, its long neck reaching up and its patterned coat showing clearly. It stands among low grass and a few small bushes, looking out over the flat land, with open sky filling the space above it.

A lion stands on the grassy plain, its tawny body low and strong, its head lifted as it looks across the open ground. Dry grass reaches around its legs, and the flat land and wide sky stretch out behind it.
A zebra stands on the plains, its black-and-white striped body clear against the dry grass. Its head is up and its tail hangs down as it rests on the flat, sunlit ground, with open sky behind it.

A large ostrich stands on the open plain, its long bare neck raised, its small head up and its big feathered body rounded. Its long legs carry it across the dry grass, with flat land and wide sky around it.

A crocodile lies low on the ground near the edge of the plains, its long body, rough scaly back and narrow snout stretched out. Its eye is visible as it rests still on the dry earth under the open sky.
A wide view of the plains: a great flat stretch of dry golden grass reaching to the horizon, with nothing but open land and a broad sky above it. The grassland spreads out calmly in every direction.

books.title: Blue
books.art_why: Every page shows real, everyday objects a child can see today, so photographs fit best.

pages.brief: A wide open blue sky filling the top of the frame above a flat green field, with a few soft white clouds drifting high up. Bright daylight, nothing else in view, a calm and simple scene that lets the blue sky be the whole subject.

A single blue bicycle helmet resting on a wooden table indoors, its strap and buckle hanging loose. Sunlight from a nearby window falls across the smooth blue shell, and the plain tabletop around it is empty, so the helmet is the only thing shown.

A blue child's bicycle standing upright on a paved path outdoors, handlebars straight and pedals still. Behind it are a low garden hedge and soft green grass in daylight. Nobody is riding it, and no other objects are near it.

A blue water bottle standing upright on a light kitchen counter, its cap closed and its surface catching the light. Beside it the counter is clear and clean, with a plain wall behind. Only the bottle is shown, still and unheld.

A blue wooden bench standing alone on a grassy patch in a park, its slats painted a deep even blue and its legs resting on the ground. Green grass and a few low bushes surround it under open sky, with nobody sitting on it.

A blue swing hanging from a metal frame in a playground, the seat empty and the chains straight and still. Beneath it is soft ground and around it glimpses of grass under a clear bright sky, with nobody playing on it.

A blue slide standing in a playground, its smooth curved chute shining in the daylight and its ladder leading up one side. The slide rests on soft playground ground with open space around it, and no children are on it.

A playground seen from a short distance, with blue play equipment standing together: a blue slide, a blue swing and blue climbing frames. Soft ground spreads beneath them and green grass and trees show behind, under a wide blue sky, with nobody playing.

books.title: Orange
books.art_why: The orange tree, pumpkin, butterfly, snake, field and sunset are real-world subjects best shown in photographs.

pages.brief: A single tree stands alone in the open, its whole shape shown clearly. All its leaves are orange, and the trunk and branches are visible. The scene focuses only on this one orange tree, with nothing else added.

One leaf is shown close up, filling most of the view. Its colour is orange, and its simple leaf shape is clear to see. The leaf rests against a plain, empty background with no other objects around it.

A single pumpkin sits in the open, shown as the only object in the picture. Its round shape and ridges are visible, and its colour is orange all over. The background is plain so the pumpkin stands out clearly.
One flower is shown alone, with its petals open. The flower is orange, and its shape is easy to see. It stands against a plain background, with no other plants or objects in the picture.

A single butterfly is shown with its wings spread open. The butterfly is orange, and its wings and body are clear to see. It appears alone against a plain background, with no flowers or other objects around it.

One snake is shown alone, with its long body stretched out. The snake is orange, and its shape is clear to see. It lies against a plain, empty background, with no other animals or objects in the picture.

A wide field fills the view, shown as one open outdoor space. The field is orange, and its flat ground stretches across the picture. Nothing else is added, so the whole scene focuses only on the orange field.
An orange sunset fills the sky, shown as the only subject in the picture. The sky glows with orange light, and the sun is low near the horizon. No people or objects are added to the scene.

books.title: Green
books.art_why: All eight things are real, living nature subjects that exist today and photograph clearly.

pages.brief: A green snake shown close up, its long green body curving across the frame, green scales catching the light, its head raised slightly with a small dark eye. Nothing else is in the picture but the snake and its own green coils.

One single green leaf shown large and close, filling the frame. Its flat green surface and the lighter green veins running out from the stem are clearly visible, with the leaf's edge softly curved against a plain empty background.

A patch of green moss shown close up, soft and thick, made of many tiny green plants packed tightly together. The moss looks slightly damp and springy, with small differences in shade across its bumpy green surface.

A green frog sitting still, shown close up. Its smooth green skin, its wide mouth and its round eyes are clearly visible, and its front legs rest on the ground beneath its body. The frog fills most of the picture.

A small green bird perched and shown close up, its green feathers smooth over its back and wings. Its head is turned to the side, its small beak and dark eye visible, its thin legs holding it in place.

A small green insect shown very close up, its green body and thin legs clearly visible. Its hard green outer body and its small head are in sharp focus, the whole tiny creature filling the middle of the picture.

A green lizard shown close up, lying still with its long green tail stretched out behind it. Its green scaly skin, small pointed head and short legs are clearly visible as it rests on the surface beneath it.

A green forest seen from a distance, many tall trees packed together with green leaves filling the view. Green branches and green treetops layer back into the picture, and the whole scene is thick with green.

books.title: Yellow
books.art_why: All the yellow things are real vehicles, signs, clothing, and road markings that exist today.

pages.brief: A single bright yellow bus fills the picture, shown clearly as the main subject. Its yellow body, windows, wheels, and door are visible. The bus sits still, alone, with no people around it and no other vehicles in view.

A single yellow light glows brightly in the center of the picture. Its warm yellow glow is the main thing shown. The light shines alone, with no people, vehicles, or other objects around it. It is the only subject in view.

A single bright yellow cab fills the picture, shown clearly as the main subject. Its yellow body, windows, wheels, and doors are visible. The cab sits still, alone, with no people around it and no other vehicles in view.

Several yellow signs are shown together, each one bright yellow and clearly visible. They stand as the main subject in the picture, with no people around them and no other objects in view. Their yellow surfaces stand out clearly.

A single bright yellow truck fills the picture, shown clearly as the main subject. Its yellow body, windows, wheels, and front are visible. The truck sits still, alone, with no people around it and no other vehicles in view.

A single yellow vest is shown on its own, clearly visible as the main subject. Its bright yellow color stands out, and its front opening and armholes are visible. The vest is alone, with no person wearing it and no other objects in view.

Bright yellow lines are shown clearly, running side by side in straight strokes. Their yellow color stands out as the main subject of the picture. The lines are alone, with no people or vehicles around them and no other objects in view.

A single yellow hat is shown alone, clearly visible as the main subject. Its yellow brim and crown stand out, and its shape is easy to see. The hat sits by itself, with no person wearing it and no other objects in view.

books.title: These Birds
books.art_why: Birds exist in the real world and can be photographed.

pages.brief: A group of doves is shown together in a clear, simple view, with soft grey feathers, small beaks, and round eyes. They stand calmly with folded wings, close enough to see their gentle faces and smooth plumage.

Several hawks are shown in a clear, simple view, with strong hooked beaks, sharp eyes, and broad wings. They perch upright with feathers neatly folded, close enough to see their alert faces and powerful shapes.

A group of crows is shown in a clear, simple view, with glossy black feathers, sturdy beaks, and bright eyes. They stand together with wings folded, close enough to see their dark shapes and smooth plumage.

Several owls are shown in a clear, simple view, with large round eyes, curved beaks, and soft patterned feathers. They sit upright with wings folded, close enough to see their calm faces and rounded bodies.

Several eagles are shown in a clear, simple view, with broad wings, strong hooked beaks, and sharp eyes. They stand upright with feathers neatly folded, close enough to see their alert faces and powerful bodies.
A group of geese is shown in a clear, simple view, with long necks, sturdy beaks, and smooth feathers. They stand together with wings folded, close enough to see their alert faces and rounded bodies.

Several turkeys are shown in a clear, simple view, with bare heads, red wattles, and fanned tail feathers. They stand together with wings neatly folded, close enough to see their patterned plumage and rounded bodies.

A mixed group of birds is shown together, with different feathers, beaks, and sizes. They stand calm and bright close in a clear, simple view, filling the picture with many kinds of small and large birds.

books.title: City Street
books.art_why: A city street and its vehicles, buildings, food, and people are real-world things that can be photographed.

pages.brief: A set of wide concrete steps in a city street setting, seen clearly from the front and slightly below. The steps are empty, with daylight falling across each tread and a plain outdoor area around them.

A long, clean sidewalk in a city street setting, stretching straight ahead beside the road. The pavement is empty and bright in daylight, with a simple edge and clear walking space shown along it near the street.
A clear view of food set out in a city street setting, with the food shown close together and easy to see. Daylight falls on it, and the surrounding area is simple so the food is the main subject.

Tall buildings are shown in a city street setting, rising together above the street. The buildings are clear and simple in daylight, with their shapes and fronts visible against the sky and no extra activity around them.
A taxi is shown clearly on a city street, with its shape and details clear. It sits in daylight on the road, and the surrounding street is simple and uncluttered so the taxi stands out.
A bus is shown clearly on a city street, with its shape and details visible. It sits in daylight on the road, and the surrounding street is simple and uncluttered so the bus stands out.

Several people are shown clearly on a city street, standing together in daylight. They are the main subject, with their forms clear and the surrounding street simple and plain so the people are easy to see.

A city street is shown from a clear viewpoint, with the road surface and outdoor space visible. Daylight falls across the scene, and the street is simple, open and empty, with no extra activity beyond the street itself.

books.title: Picking Apples
books.art_why: Apple picking, farmers, tractors and orchards all exist today and photograph clearly.

pages.brief: A farmer standing in an apple orchard, wearing work clothes and a wide-brimmed hat, looking toward the camera with a calm, friendly expression. Rows of apple trees and open grass stretch behind the farmer in soft daylight.

A red tractor parked on the grass at the edge of an orchard, big rear wheels and small front wheels clearly visible, a metal seat and steering wheel on top. Apple trees stand in rows behind it in bright daylight.

A single apple tree shown full height in an orchard, thick brown trunk and wide green leafy branches, red apples growing among the leaves. Short grass and a few fallen apples lie on the ground beneath it.
An empty woven basket sitting on the grass in an apple orchard, handle upright and round opening open and ready. Apple trees with red fruit and short green grass fill the background in soft daylight.
A tall wooden ladder leaning against an apple tree in an orchard, rungs reaching up into the leafy branches full of red apples. Grass and the tree trunk show at the bottom in clear daylight.

Two or three friends standing together on the grass in an apple orchard, smiling and facing each other, relaxed and ready to work. Apple trees heavy with red fruit stand behind them under a bright sky.
A wooden wagon resting on the grass near the orchard, flat bed and low sides empty and clean, wheels and a handle visible. Apple trees with red apples stand in rows behind it in daylight.
A pile of freshly picked red apples gathered together, shiny skins and short green stems, some resting in a heap on the grass. A few more apples and leafy orchard branches show softly behind them.

books.title: Valentine's Day Gifts
books.art_why: Real Valentine gifts exist today and can be photographed.

pages.brief: A small group of wrapped Valentine gifts sits together on a plain surface, with neat paper, ribbons, and bows in soft red and pink tones. The packages are arranged clearly so each gift can be seen.

A bunch of fresh flowers stands in a simple vase on a clean table, in gentle light. The colorful blossoms and green stems are clearly visible, arranged as a Valentine's Day gift with soft petals and leaves.
A plate of decorated cookies rests on a table. The round cookies are topped with pink and red icing, making a sweet Valentine's Day gift, and their simple shapes and colors are easy to see.

Several colorful balloons float above a plain surface, tied with thin ribbons. The round balloons are bright and cheerful, gathered together as a Valentine's Day gift in red, pink, and white tones, with their strings hanging down.

A small assortment of colorful candy sits in a clear dish on a clean surface. The individual pieces are bright and sweet-looking, with red, pink, and white colors, arranged as a simple Valentine's Day gift.
A soft teddy bear sits upright alone on a plain background, with round ears, plush fur, and a gentle expression. The cuddly bear is shown clearly in soft light as a warm Valentine's Day gift.
A box of chocolates is open on a clean table, showing neat rows of small pieces. The sweets are clearly visible and arranged as a Valentine's Day gift, with smooth shapes and rich brown colors.
A single Valentine's Day card rests on a plain surface, slightly folded and ready to give. The card is decorated with a heart and simple red and pink designs, shown clearly as a sweet Valentine gift.

books.title: Black
books.art_why: A stage, clothing, a wand and a real rabbit all exist today and photograph clearly.

pages.brief: A small theatre stage seen from the front, everything black: black curtains hanging down both sides, black wooden floorboards and a black backdrop behind. The stage stands empty with nobody on it, and soft light shows the deep, velvety folds of the dark fabric.

A single black sheet spread out flat and smooth, its dark cloth filling the picture. The fabric lies evenly with soft folds and a slightly darker shadow along one edge, showing how deep and solid the black colour looks.

One black suit shown complete, a dark jacket with matching trousers, neatly laid out so the whole outfit can be seen at once. The cloth is deep black, with the jacket collar and buttons just visible against the darker fabric.

A single black necktie held up straight, its long dark shape hanging down narrow at the top and wider below. The silk-like cloth is deep black with a soft sheen along the middle where the light touches it.

One black cape hanging open, a long sweeping cloak of dark cloth. The wide folds fall in heavy curves, and the deep black fabric shows soft highlights where the light catches the edges of the draping material.
A single black top hat standing alone, tall and round with a wide flat brim. The whole hat is deep black, and a faint shine runs along the curve of the crown and the smooth surface of the brim.
One black wand resting across the picture, a thin straight rod pointed at the tip. It is completely black along its length, and a soft gleam of light runs down the smooth surface from end to end.
A black rabbit sitting still, its whole body covered in dark fur. Long ears stand up, dark eyes look forward, and soft light shows the fuzzy texture of the fur and the shape of its small front paws.

books.title: White
books.art_why: Everything shown—snow, flowers, animals, eggs and an igloo—exists in the real world and can be photographed.

pages.brief: A simple outdoor view shows a broad expanse of white snow covering the ground from edge to edge. The snow looks soft and thick, filling the whole scene with a calm, cold brightness and no other objects in view.

A close view shows white flowers with soft petals gathered together in a simple natural setting. The flowers are the main focus, filling the picture with bright white shapes and a calm, gentle feeling.
A white fox stands in a simple open setting, its fur pale and thick. The fox looks toward the viewer with pointed ears and a bushy tail, alone and still in the picture.
A large white whale swims through open blue water, its body long and smooth. The whale is alone in the sea, with its head and tail visible as it moves calmly through the water.
A white seal rests on a plain icy surface, its round body pale and smooth. The seal looks calm and still, alone in the cold setting with nothing else in the picture.

A small group of white eggs sits together in a simple setting. The eggs are smooth and pale, close together and clearly visible, with the picture focusing only on the eggs and their soft white shells.
A white owl stands in a simple open setting, its feathers pale and soft. The owl faces forward with round eyes and folded wings, alone and still in the picture.
A white igloo stands in a plain snowy landscape, its rounded blocks forming a small dome. The igloo is alone in the cold open space, with no people or animals in view.

books.title: The Baseball Game
books.art_why: Real baseball equipment, uniforms and a field can be photographed directly.

pages.brief: A wide, clear view of a baseball field outdoors, showing the open grassy area and the dirt infield where the game is played. The field is empty and still, with no players in view, presented as a simple single subject for young readers to recognize.

A single baseball base sits in place on the dirt of the field. It is a square white cushion, low to the ground, shown close and clear so a young child can see exactly what a base looks like in the game.

A baseball bat is shown alone against a simple background, standing upright so its shape is easy to see. The bat is smooth and tapered, with a handle end and a thicker hitting end, ready for a player to swing.

A single baseball fills the view, round and stitched, resting on a plain surface. The small ball is clearly shown with its curved seams, presented alone as the simple subject of the page so young readers can look closely at it.

A baseball cap is shown on its own, with a rounded crown and a curved brim at the front. The hat sits plainly in view against a simple background, ready to be worn by a player, and it is the only object on the page.

A baseball helmet is shown alone, hard and rounded with a protective shell and a front brim. It sits plainly in view against a simple background, the kind of helmet a batter wears, and it is the only object presented on the page.

A baseball uniform is shown as a complete set of clothing: a jersey and pants, standing without a person inside. The uniform is simple and clear in the frame, the only subject on the page, ready for a player to wear.

A colourful rainbow arcs across the sky after spring rain. Its bands of colour stand out against soft clouds and pale blue sky, stretching over a green landscape below, bright and clear in the fresh spring air.

A small spring bunny sits on green grass. Its long ears, soft fur and bright eyes are visible as it pauses in the open, with fresh greenery and soft daylight around it, calm and clear for young readers.

A bright spring scene shows fresh green grass, soft sunlight and new spring growth all around. The open outdoor setting feels warm and lively, with blossoms and leaves gently visible and a calm seasonal atmosphere that clearly presents spring to young readers.
